family.name: RNase P subunit p30

history.description: Fifteen graphs retain twenty-four observed effects across five mapped reference proteins and four primary studies. Protein-pair and buffer interventions remain distinct from p30-specific mutation and whole-gene yeast phenotypes; mixed RNP preparations are not isolated-protein catalysis. Assay discrepancies, missing supplemental controls and broader member coverage remain open. Status remains IN_PROGRESS.
history.summary: Curate p30 RNA reconstitution mutation and yeast-processing causal contexts

history.description: Same-agent partial scientific review supports twenty-four scoped effects in fifteen graphs. Five member mappings and four primary studies are retained; composite protocols, mixed RNP activity, residual mutation effects and uninspected supplements constrain interpretation. Additional members, exact constructs, assay discrepancies and folding or assembly controls remain open. No REVIEWED promotion or publication.
